wide_contrast_rows_full.teaches: Whether a citation supports a claim is separate from whether the cited information is correct
A last-reviewed date for accuracy is a property separate from publication or modification dates
supersedes S024 — lastReviewed records the date a web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness; no comparison to other date properties claimed
Compute declared recheck deadlines at an explicit as-of date, leaving event and unknown schedules distinct from current or overdue
Review updates may follow a protocol-specified fixed interval approved by the editorial team; this is separate from ongoing evidence searches
Distinguish a valid common path from a character prefix, and keep canonical-path computation separate from an application's policy judgment

A bare command name is sought in the colon-separated `PATH` list rather than a fixed path (the page states the list, not its order; the round-35 S1 measurement shows a first-listed shim winning), and a name containing a slash bypasses `PATH` entirely.
`sha256sum` prints or checks SHA256 (256-bit) checksums, and `--check` reads checksums from files rather than computing a policy.
Design and keep the complete search strategies in a log document rather than in the database, so the steps taken stay accountable and reproducible

evidence selection is measured rather than assumed: 95.42% precision and 72.36% recall against the super-annotators' set, and the authors' own validation found 91.2% of sampled examples correctly annotated

a citation is stored as a source_url together with an archive link to that url, and the claim carries a claim_date, so a verdict can be re-read against the state of its evidence rather than against a live page that has since changed
explicitly requesting blob contents selects repository object bytes rather than working-tree bytes
A repair line must be validated against the bytes it names, and the pointer audit must cover every block rather than the newest
supersedes S197 — A self-assessment counter validates each resolution line against the bytes it claims to repair, and its audit window covers every block rather than the newest.
a registry row's teaches cell is judged against its own capture, and a superseded row's cell is disposed as superseded rather than read

independent_date_contrast_sweep.teaches: A review's currency is assessed on a schedule, not only when someone notices; deciding to update is a recorded, periodic act
A last-reviewed date for accuracy is a property separate from publication or modification dates
supersedes S019 — Cochrane reviews should be assessed periodically to decide whether an update is needed; this sentence does not prescribe a recorded schedule
supersedes S024 — lastReviewed records the date a web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness; no comparison to other date properties claimed
supersedes S021 — in this study a signal potentially warranting an update occurred within 2 years for 23% of reviews; a signal is not itself an update
Compute declared recheck deadlines at an explicit as-of date, leaving event and unknown schedules distinct from current or overdue
Review updates may follow a protocol-specified fixed interval approved by the editorial team; this is separate from ongoing evidence searches
Validate ASCII input in the same representation arithmetic accepts; normalize decimal magnitude without a recursive match on the zero prefix

A `sha256()` object digests the concatenation of data fed through `update()`; `hexdigest()` returns a string twice the digest's byte length with hexadecimal digits, but the docs do not specify output letter case
a Memento-Datetime header is a promise that the reflected resource state will no longer change; an archived body may not be byte-to-byte the same as what the origin served

a verdict binds to a Wikipedia URL and a sentence id while the format section names no page revision, and the pages ship as one dated pre-processed dump, so a later reader resolves the sentence inside a fixed pool

a citation is stored as a source_url together with an archive link to that url, and the claim carries a claim_date, so a verdict can be re-read against the state of its evidence rather than against a live page that has since changed

evidence is admitted only where it predates the claim and a two-stage sufficiency check gates each verdict, so an archived copy can be judged against the claim's own date instead of against whatever the web holds now

30,012 manually created claims over Chinese Wikipedia are each labelled Supports, Refutes or Not Enough Info, and the Supports and Refutes claims are also annotated with evidence sentences from one or more Chinese Wikipedia pages, so the FEVER label set and evidence requirement carry over to Chinese unchanged

each of 1,535 real-world claims got five retrieved candidate sentences that humans labelled one by one as supporting, refuting or not giving enough information (7,675 claim-evidence pairs), and the claim label is aggregated from those micro-verdicts, DISPUTED when both supporting and refuting evidence are present

a DOI can only be used as a URL 1 to a few days after J-STAGE publication; for works registered in the external services J-STAGE links to, citation and cited-by DOI links are created from a few days to two weeks after publication; J-STAGE keeps a Portico dark archive and screens submissions against iThenticate for similarity

CNKI's own published definition of the citation check (compares an entered citation against 中国知网's literature resources), its result-list columns and its three states (没找到, an orange marker, a green marker) with the middle state naming the differing part; §6.1 publishes no matching method

the article recommends (望ましい) recording together who conducted the search, the date and the search expression used, so that others can reproduce the search; it notes PRISMA is translated into Japanese with a checklist appended and names no search-reporting extension

the record names the databases searched, the date bound from each database's inception to 2024-04-01 and the combination of controlled terms with keywords; it states no boolean string and does not mention grey literature

item 6 asks every source to be named — databases, registries, websites, organisations, reference lists and other routes — with the search or query date of each source; item 7 asks the complete strategy, filters and limits included, for databases, registries and websites only

the template requires the review's search period to be stated and sets its end between the decision on the analysis framework and the submission, asks for the databases and search expressions used under a PRISMA lead and counts hand-searched unpublished data in the flow chart; it names no searcher and no date of search

item 6 asks for every database, registry, website, organisation and reference list consulted and the date each was last searched; item 7 asks for the complete strategy with filters and limits for databases, registries and websites; the table counts reviewers for screening and data collection and has no searcher item

the commentary recommends a record count for each information source, routes citation searching and other methods to Column 2 and databases and registers to Column 1, puts per-source detail in supplementary materials when the diagram has no room, and treats an update search as one data point per database

the portal shows this standard as 现行, with 中文标准名称 信息与文献 参考文献著录规则, an English title, CCS A14 and ICS 01.140.20, published 2025-12-02 and effective 2026-07-01; where a text would stand it states that, because the standard adopts ISO and IEC standards, the portal's own system serves no text-reading service for copyright reasons — a statement about this portal's service for this standard, not that the text is unavailable elsewhere

REJECTED: a docstring states intent; the page (S138) has no text on os.open or Python (0 hits for os.open and Python in the rendered page) and the expected values of P01, P02, P03 and P11 are typed constants, so the count measures agreement with the author; flip: each expected value cited to a sentence of S134 or S138 or marked inference, which the landed corpus/evidence/round62/openat2-probe.py docstring now does, so the flip is met for the landed file and the candidate row stays rejected
Bind a candidate-running counter only after a committed detection-forger battery passes it; correct a miscounted token count append-only, never by rewriting the authored lesson
A repair line must be validated against the bytes it names, and the pointer audit must cover every block rather than the newest
supersedes S197 — A self-assessment counter validates each resolution line against the bytes it claims to repair, and its audit window covers every block rather than the newest.

backward and forward citation searching are direct citation searching; supplement, never replace, a recall-oriented database search; two indexes, deduplicate, iterate, report seeds/directionality/dates/iterations/indexes
203 means a transforming proxy modified the enclosed content from the origin server's 200 response, so a 203 body is not the origin's representation
